elements.label: Ribbon callout caption (exiting)
elements.text: One-click pivot between metrics, traces, and logs

pattern.description: A two-line magenta/orange ribbon caption sitting over a live log view is wiped off left-to-right by a hard-edged mask: the left part of both lines disappears first while the right part stays put, the ribbon shape clipped with an angled edge.
pattern.why_premium: The caption leaves by the same mask direction it entered, so the exit reads as part of the brand system rather than a fade; the UI underneath stays fully still, keeping the viewer's eye on the log rows the caption was pointing at.

build_hint.gsap: Caption ribbon in a wrapper with clip-path: tl.to('.ribbon', {clipPath: 'inset(0 0 0 100%)', duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.in'}); both lines share one mask so they wipe together (optionally line 2 delayed 0.03s). Background UI untouched.
build_hint.remotion: clipPath inset-left = interpolate(frame, [start, start+21], [0, 100], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) applied to the ribbon container; no spring needed for a mask exit.

notes: No candidate box matches the caption exactly; b02 (diff region) is the closest and covers most of its swept area (caption right edge extends ~50px beyond b02). Energy spikes every ~5 frames suggest the underlying screen recording runs at a lower frame rate (duplicate frames), not separate events. camera.move is none; the small scale sum is the caption change, not a camera move.
